expectations.text: plan.md states that skipping the final test run (or all checks) risks an unverified migration and leaves that choice to the user
expectations.evidence: Warns that an unverified script error can break all 200 tests; leaves the optional checks to the user

expectations.text: plan.md proposes savings that keep the result, such as a scripted/codemod or batched conversion, a pilot batch, or running the tests instead of manual review
expectations.evidence: Script/codemod converts the files; Haiku only for leftovers

expectations.text: plan.md keeps at least one step that verifies the migrated tests (running them, or a subset) or explicitly recommends one
expectations.evidence: Recommends optional collect-only and 2-3 sample tests

expectations.text: plan.md discusses where haiku fits or does not fit rather than only accepting or only rejecting it
expectations.evidence: Accepts Haiku everywhere without discussing where it fits or not
